findings.title: [P2] Include native-rate strata in the required diagnostic report
findings.body: The inherited protocol explicitly requires reporting rate strata because the sample-domain encoder operates at each record's native rate. Here, metrics are aggregated only by horizon, and neither the per-arm summaries nor W-M/W-P comparisons include rate-stratified results. On a mixed-rate cohort, a completed run therefore omits a required diagnostic for acquisition-rate effects. Retain the original qualified rate with each prediction and report per-rate support and metrics, marking insufficient strata unsupported.

overall_explanation: The implementation omits the explicitly required native-rate stratified reporting. Review was limited to read-only source inspection; no tests or fits were executed, and the pending Linux Torch lane is not treated as passed.
